title: Benchmark1d2d model configuration
description: How one model was set up for its published results (protocol 4.0): which engine build, which configuration tier, and every setting that differs from the engine's own default, with the reason. One file per configuration under configurations/. A result is always shown with its configuration, and results of different tiers are never compared as if alike.

key.description: The model key used by score cards and the site (site/pages.py SOLVERS).

pin.description: Exact install: package pin, installer hash or source commit.

tier.description: T0 out of the box: the engine's defaults, plus only what the case itself defines (geometry, boundaries, friction, grid). T1 documented guidance: only changes the developer's own published guidance recommends for this kind of flow, each with its source. T2 expert: any setting the engine exposes, chosen by a named person or group; one configuration per capability group unless per_case_tuning is declared.

set_by.description: Who chose the configuration: 'suite' for configurations the suite's runners write, else the person or organisation that submitted it.

script.description: The runner that writes the native model files.

changed_from_default.description: Every setting that differs from the engine's default. Empty means none is known to differ; see defaults_audit for how far that has been checked.

source.description: For T1, the developer's guidance this follows (document and section).

defaults_audit.description: automatic: changed_from_default is produced by diffing the written model against the engine's defaults on every run. manual: it was checked by hand against the engine's documentation. pending: not yet checked; the list holds only the changes the runner makes deliberately.

per_case_tuning.description: True if settings differ from case to case within a capability group (T2 only).

training_disclosure.description: For learned models: what the model was trained on, and whether any suite case, reference or generator was used.
